lines.t: Hollow Knight Silksong took so long, a YouTube channel posted daily news about it for almost 1,700 days.
Silksong started as extra content for Hollow Knight, where you'd play as Hornet.

sc.sub: a Kickstarter stretch goal: play as Hornet

lines.t: But it grew too big, so the tiny team at Team Cherry turned it into a whole new game.

sc.sub: Team Cherry never grew the team

lines.t: You play as Hornet, a fan favorite from the first game, in a brand new land called Pharloom.
lines.say: You play as Hornet, a fan favorite from the first game, in a brand new land called Far-loom.

lines.t: It was announced on Valentine's Day 2019.
Then fans waited. And waited. A delay in 2023 made it worse.
Fans turned the wait into memes, with clown pictures and the Daily Silksong News channel.
The release date was revealed just two weeks before launch: September 4th, 2025.
On launch day, Steam and other stores crashed.
Over 500,000 people played it on Steam on day one.
Five million people played in the first three days.

sc.label: PLAYERS IN 3 DAYS
sc.sub: Steam, Xbox Game Pass and more

lines.t: By December, it had sold over seven million copies.
It won Best Action Adventure at The Game Awards, and Game of the Year at the Steam Awards.
It also won the Steam award for Best Game You Suck At.
